interpretation: Earlier failed traces remain failures under their original unchanged budgets. The final separate six-case production matrix passed. Private card-skip and unchanged-production recovery windows do not isolate thumbnail causality. Earlier 2x controls with late or Game Over ending evidence are excluded from active-play acceptance. Scheduling varied across diagnostic windows; the standard high-performance WebGL hint is advisory, not proof of an exclusive cause, dedicated GPU selection, universal smoothness or presented FPS.
limitations: Host live-preview state is external controller context; the in-page probe records document.visibilityState, not whether the host preview is shown.
rAF scheduling and native callback CPU do not measure presented frames, GPU completion, or foreground visual smoothness.
Clock-only zero callback/save sample counts mean those timing hooks were disabled, not that the game performed no work.
Native callback timing excludes asynchronous compositor/GPU completion; save-capture timing excludes asynchronous worker/IndexedDB latency.
Active-play claims require separate before/after board-progression evidence so automatic pause/focus behavior cannot be mistaken for active work.
Failed visible-host-preview observations remain failures of their original25/50ms scheduling budget; later scoped background-host observations do not erase or reclassify them.

nativeOptionsEvidence.nativeRendererSelection: Not shown in this More Options image. A WebGL context alone does not distinguish native software versus3D rendering; renderer must be matched separately.

parentComparison.status: One matched prior-release 1x active window passed. Current retake and same-origin current comparison failed. The later old-release 2x control ended Game Over and exceeded the save p95 budget; it is not accepted full-active 2x evidence. No exclusive version-causality conclusion.

externalNativeOptions.evidence: Publisher matched through native UI; separate renderer and More Options images retained.

attemptedSoftwareDiagnostic.label: v2-scrap1-software-active20-1x-native
attemptedSoftwareDiagnostic.qualification: The software setting was requested before importing/reloading, but post-import native Options visibly had3D Acceleration checked again. The report label is preserved verbatim and must not be treated as software-renderer performance evidence.

appliedSoftwareDiagnostic.label: v2-scrap1-appliedsoftware-active20-1x-native
appliedSoftwareDiagnostic.qualification: Unlike the earlier software-labeled attempt, native3D was switched off after import, Options closed and reopened, and the unchecked value captured before this window. This actual software run fails the original native-callback p95 budget as well as the rAF budget.

unchangedProductionRecovery.interpretation: Unchanged productiona9 passed on the same4244 origin after private card-isolation. This is not evidence that removing the card fixed anything. A long tool/file-chooser stall and time/environment changes confound that sequence; no productionC++ fix is supported. Final full production capture matrix remains separately required.

production2xLateEndshot.qualification: Timing budgets passed, but the operator obtained the ending image late after extra unpaused time and native ending UI appeared. Excluded from all-active acceptance.

production2xArtifactWatcherRetake.qualification: Original rAF budget failed. A host Python artifact watcher ran during this window, but a subsequent quiet window also failed; watcher causality is not established.

production2xQuietRetake.qualification: Quiet window still failed the original rAF budget. Low synchronous native callback elapsed times do not explain the scheduling gap or establish presented smoothness.

parent2xEndedControl.qualification: Old release control ended Game Over after extra unpaused setup; full-active 2x evidence is invalid. rAF timing passed, but save p95 8.1 ms exceeds the unchanged 8 ms limit.

privateCardSkip.qualification: Private native card-skip diagnostic passed after a roughly 2176-second file-picker/tool stall. A later unchanged production window also passed; this does not support a thumbnail-cause or C++ fix claim.

privateHighPreference2x.qualification: Bounded private shell-only advisory-hint diagnostic passed with unchanged native a9/ea0. This is a diagnostic, not the final release matrix or an isolated causal comparison.

finalProductionMatrix.limitations: Short single-machine windows measure rAF scheduling and synchronous callback/save elapsed wall time, not displayed FPS, GPU completion, or universal performance. Clock-only empty timing arrays mean disabled timing hooks, not zero work. Local evidence precedes publication; Pages reruns native checks before deployment.
